sub_graphs.title: EIP-1153: TSTORE Opcode Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the TSTORE opcode execution flow for writing to transient storage

nodes.label: TSTORE Opcode Invoked
nodes.description: EVM has encountered TSTORE opcode (0x5d) during execution

nodes.label: Check STATICCALL Context
nodes.description: Verify that execution is not within a STATICCALL context

nodes.label: In STATICCALL Context
nodes.description: Execution is within a read-only STATICCALL frame

nodes.label: Not in Static Context
nodes.description: Execution allows state modifications

nodes.label: Throw Static Context Exception
nodes.description: Abort execution due to write attempt in STATICCALL

nodes.label: Pop Address and Value from Stack
nodes.description: Pop two 32-byte words: top word is address, next is value

nodes.label: Arguments Ready
nodes.description: Transient storage address and value have been extracted

nodes.label: Deduct 100 Gas
nodes.description: Charge 100 gas (same as warm SSTORE of dirty slot)

nodes.label: Gas Deducted
nodes.description: 100 gas has been charged for TSTORE

nodes.label: Write to Transient Storage
nodes.description: Store 32-byte value at 32-byte address in contract's transient storage

nodes.label: TSTORE Complete
nodes.description: Value has been written to transient storage

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1153: TLOAD Opcode Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the TLOAD opcode execution flow for reading from transient storage

nodes.label: TLOAD Opcode Invoked
nodes.description: EVM has encountered TLOAD opcode (0x5c) during execution

nodes.label: Pop Address from Stack
nodes.description: Pop one 32-byte word as the transient storage address

nodes.label: Address Ready
nodes.description: Transient storage address has been extracted from stack

nodes.label: Deduct 100 Gas
nodes.description: Charge 100 gas (same as hot SLOAD)

nodes.label: Gas Deducted
nodes.description: 100 gas has been charged for TLOAD

nodes.label: Read from Transient Storage
nodes.description: Fetch 32-byte value from transient storage at given address

nodes.label: Value Fetched
nodes.description: Value has been read from transient storage (or zero if unset)

nodes.label: Push Value to Stack
nodes.description: Push the fetched 32-byte value onto the stack

nodes.label: TLOAD Complete
nodes.description: Value is on stack, TLOAD execution finished

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1153: Transient Storage Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of transient storage values within a transaction

nodes.label: Transaction Execution Started
nodes.description: A new transaction has begun execution

nodes.label: Transient Storage Empty
nodes.description: All transient storage slots for all contracts are initialized to zero

nodes.label: TSTORE Write Operation
nodes.description: Contract writes a value to transient storage

nodes.label: Transient Storage Populated
nodes.description: Transient storage contains non-zero values

nodes.label: New Call Frame Entered
nodes.description: Execution has entered a sub-call (CALL, DELEGATECALL, etc.)

nodes.label: Access Transient Storage from Sub-Call
nodes.description: Sub-call accesses transient storage (shared across all frames)

nodes.label: Call Frame Reverted
nodes.description: A call frame has reverted

nodes.label: Rollback Transient Storage Changes
nodes.description: Undo all transient storage writes made in the reverted frame

nodes.label: Transient Storage Rolled Back
nodes.description: Transient storage restored to state before reverted frame

nodes.label: Transaction Execution Ended
nodes.description: Transaction has completed (success or failure)

nodes.label: Discard All Transient Storage
nodes.description: All transient storage values are discarded at end of transaction

nodes.label: Transient Storage Cleared
nodes.description: Transient storage is empty, ready for next transaction

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1153: Transient Storage Ownership Model
sub_graphs.description: Models how transient storage ownership varies based on call type

nodes.label: Contract Code Executing
nodes.description: A contract is currently executing code

nodes.label: Determine Transient Storage Owner
nodes.description: Identify which address owns the transient storage being accessed

nodes.label: Regular CALL/STATICCALL
nodes.description: Execution context is a CALL or STATICCALL

nodes.label: DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE
nodes.description: Execution context is DELEGATECALL or CALLCODE

nodes.label: Owner is Callee (Target Contract)
nodes.description: Transient storage belongs to the contract whose code is running

nodes.label: Owner is Caller
nodes.description: Transient storage belongs to the calling contract (caller's context)

nodes.label: Access Callee's Transient Storage
nodes.description: Read/write to transient storage owned by the callee

nodes.label: Access Caller's Transient Storage
nodes.description: Read/write to transient storage owned by the caller

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'same as a warm SSTORE of a dirty slot' assumes familiarity with EIP-2929 access list semantics, but does not explicitly define what happens if EIP-2929 is not active.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-1153 requires EIP-2929 to be active, and the 100 gas cost is fixed regardless of access list state.

ambiguities.text: The specification states TSTORE 'does not require gasleft to be less than or equal to the gas stipend' but does not clarify if this means there is no minimum gas check at all.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume TSTORE only requires sufficient gas (100) to complete, with no additional minimum gas requirements unlike SSTORE.

implicit_assumptions.description: The maximum transient storage allocation (~9.15MB per 30M gas transaction) will not cause out-of-memory conditions in client implementations.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious transactions could cause client crashes by allocating maximum transient storage, leading to denial of service.

implicit_assumptions.description: Developers will understand that transient storage values persist across the entire transaction, not just within a single call frame.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Developers may incorrectly use transient storage as a replacement for memory mappings, leading to reentrancy vulnerabilities where attackers exploit the transaction-wide persistence.

implicit_assumptions.description: Contracts will clear transient storage slots to zero when no longer needed within a transaction.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stale transient storage values could be read by subsequent calls in the same transaction, leading to unexpected behavior or security issues.
